landmarks.source: Original open rotunda and curved colonnades; placement from DataSF footprints, architectural form and dimensions from California Office of Historic Preservation. Collision parts in palace-of-fine-arts.json share the generated model geometry. Exhibition hall remains intact.

Origin = clock tower centre; footprint and heading from DataSF building footprints (ynuv-fyni) sf16_bldgid 201006.0000058. Clock nodes clock_*_N/E/S/W name MODEL-frame dials (N = front, -Z), not compass points; placed here they face N 233.8 (SW), E 323.8 (NW), S 53.8 (NE), W 143.8 (SE). See assets/blender/README.md.
Embarcadero Plaza on the Market St axis, facing up Market (Wikipedia coordinate cross-checked against DataSF street centrelines). See assets/blender/README.md.

Interim proxy: three-legged lattice, published dimensions (297.8 m). Centre and leg bearings from the LiDAR crossarm footprints; replaces the probe's six records and draws each where the sim has it. Site: assets/imports/fog-city-landmarks/source/assets/blender/data/landmark-sites.json; see assets/imports/fog-city-landmarks/README.md.
